title: Kinematics of Motion in a Straight Line Module 6 Lesson 1: Find Constants Build Expressions custom practice

evidence_basis.originality_note: All prompts, numerical values and physical configurations are original; mapped Cambridge past-paper evidence informs cognitive demand and assessment structure only.

parts.prompt: A particle moves in a straight line with acceleration $a = 6t - 4\text{ m s}^{-2}$ for $t \ge 0$. Given that the particle has initial velocity $v(0) = 5\text{ m s}^{-1}$, find an expression for its velocity $v$ in terms of $t$, and calculate $v(3)$.

A particle moves with velocity $v = 3t^2 - 6t + 2\text{ m s}^{-1}$. At $t = 0$, the displacement of the particle from a fixed point $O$ is $s = 4\text{ m}$. Find the displacement of the particle when $t = 2\text{ s}$.
A particle starts from rest at $t = 0$ and moves with acceleration $a = 12t^{1/2}\text{ m s}^{-2}$ for $t \ge 0$. Find the velocity of the particle when $t = 4\text{ s}$.

A particle moves with velocity $v = 6t - 2\text{ m s}^{-1}$. Given that the displacement $s = 15\text{ m}$ when $t = 2\text{ s}$, find the constant of integration and calculate the displacement when $t = 3\text{ s}$.

A particle moves such that for $t \ge 1$, its acceleration is $a = 18t^{-3}\text{ m s}^{-2}$. Given that the velocity approaches $4\text{ m s}^{-1}$ as $t \to \infty$, find the velocity of the particle when $t = 3\text{ s}$.

A particle moves with acceleration $a = 4\text{ m s}^{-2}$. At $t = 0$, its velocity is $v = 3\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and its displacement from $O$ is $s = 10\text{ m}$. Find the displacement of the particle when $t = 5\text{ s}$.

questions.prompt: A particle $P$ moves in a straight line. The acceleration of $P$ at time $t\text{ s}$ ($t \ge 0$) is given by $a = 6t - 8\text{ m s}^{-2}$. At $t = 0$, $P$ passes through a fixed origin $O$ with velocity $9\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find expressions for the velocity $v$ and displacement $s$ of $P$ in terms of $t$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Show that $P$ is never at instantaneous rest, and find the minimum velocity of $P$.

questions.prompt: A particle starts from rest at point $O$ at $t = 0$. Its acceleration $a\text{ m s}^{-2}$ at time $t\text{ s}$ ($0 \le t \le 9$) is given by $a = 6t^{1/2} - 4t$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find an expression for the velocity $v$ in terms of $t$, and find the non-zero value of $t$ at which the particle comes instantaneously to rest.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the displacement of the particle when it comes to instantaneous rest at $t = 4\text{ s}$.

questions.prompt: A particle $P$ starts from a fixed origin $O$ with velocity $2\text{ m s}^{-1}$ at $t = 0$. The acceleration $a\text{ m s}^{-2}$ of $P$ at time $t\text{ s}$ is given by $a = k(6t - 3t^2)$, where $k$ is a constant. When $t = 2\text{ s}$, the velocity of $P$ is $10\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Show that $k = 2$, and write expressions for the velocity $v$ and displacement $s$ of $P$ in terms of $t$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of $P$ when its velocity is a maximum, and find the displacement of $P$ at this instant.

questions.prompt: A particle moves in a straight line from a point $O$. The velocity $v\text{ m s}^{-1}$ of the particle $t\text{ s}$ after leaving $O$ is given by $v = k(t^2 - 6t + 8)$, where $k$ is a positive constant. The displacement of the particle from $O$ is $24\text{ m}$ when $t = 6\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the value of $k$ and write an expression for the displacement $s(t)$ from $O$ in terms of $t$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the displacement of the particle from $O$ when its velocity is a minimum.

questions.prompt: A test rocket motor ignites at $t = 1\text{ s}$ along a straight horizontal track. Its acceleration for $t \ge 1$ is modeled by $a = 24t^{-1/2} - 6\text{ m s}^{-2}$. At $t = 1\text{ s}$, the velocity of the rocket is $50\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and its displacement from the launch tower is $50\text{ m}$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find expressions for the velocity $v$ and displacement $s$ of the rocket in terms of $t$ for $t \ge 1$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the time at which the velocity of the rocket is a maximum, and calculate this maximum velocity.

questions.prompt:
A cyclist starts from rest at a fixed point $O$ at time $t = 0$ and moves in a straight line before coming to rest $k$ seconds later. The acceleration of the cyclist at time $t\text{ s}$ ($0 < t \le k$) is given by:
$$a = 6t^{-1/2} - 2t^{1/2}$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the value of $k$, and find the maximum speed of the cyclist.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find an expression for the displacement $s$ from $O$ in terms of $t$, and calculate the total distance travelled by the cyclist from $t = 0$ until coming to rest at $t = 9\text{ s}$.

questions.prompt:
Two particles, $A$ and $B$, move along the same straight line from a fixed origin $O$.
Particle $A$ passes $O$ at $t = 0$ with velocity $4\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and moves with displacement $s_A = 2t^2 + 4t\text{ m}$.
Particle $B$ starts from rest at $O$ at $t = 0$ and moves with variable acceleration $a_B = 6t - 2\text{ m s}^{-2}$ for $t \ge 0$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Derive expressions for the velocity $v_B$ and displacement $s_B$ of particle $B$ in terms of $t$, confirming all integration constants.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the non-zero time at which particle $B$ overtakes particle $A$, and find their velocities and distance from $O$ at this instant.
